resources.string: Daily or weekly screen time of the children
Kinsight: an event on a child\'s phone
%1$s: the phone left the family group
%1$s: the Nearby devices permission was turned off
%1$s: part of the screen time history is missing
%1$s: location turned off on the phone
%1$s: location was off on the phone for %2$s
%1$s: app blocking turned off on the phone
%1$s: app blocking was off on the phone for %2$s
%1$s: %2$s unblocked by PIN until the end of the day
Last in contact %1$s. The phone may be off or without internet and Bluetooth, or Kinsight was stopped or removed on it.
%1$s can now see your screen time
A new parent joined your family group. More → Who sees my data shows everyone.
A child passed a daily limit you set (it only notifies, nothing is blocked)
Tap to see today\'s screen time.
This phone is already in a family group. To join another one, leave the current group first.
Leaving the group: telling your family…
Kinsight stopped part way while clearing this phone\'s data (%1$s). Try again. If it keeps failing, clear the app\'s storage in Android settings.
A child\'s phone stopped sharing or counting: a pause, a permission or access turned off, a stop, leaving the group, no contact
Things that need nothing from you: a short Bluetooth break, a clock change, a gap in the data
Someone new can see your screen time
Time during the pause is sent once sharing is resumed.
Ask for usage access to be turned back on: Android Settings → Usage access → Kinsight.
To see its screen time again, invite this phone again.
Sync is started again in Kinsight on the child\'s phone: More → Sync → Start sync.
Ask for Kinsight\'s notifications to be allowed again on the child\'s phone.
Without this permission the phone cannot reach the family. Ask for it to be allowed in Kinsight\'s app settings.
Kinsight works again once it is opened on the child\'s phone.
The data of that time arrives once the phones are in contact again.
No screen time was recorded for this time. If it happens often, check the battery settings on the child\'s phone.
Nothing to do: Kinsight keeps the hours right after a clock change.
Without it Kinsight cannot tell where the phone is. Ask for “Allow all the time” in Kinsight\'s settings.
Without it Kinsight cannot tell where the phone is. Ask for location to be turned back on in the quick settings.
Kinsight\'s accessibility service is disabled, so blocked apps open. Ask for it to be turned back on in Settings → Accessibility.
A parent typed the PIN on the phone. The app is blocked again tomorrow.
Open Kinsight to see what changed.
Open Kinsight to see where the phone is now.
